name: service-marketplace
description: A modern service marketplace template built with React and Node.js

scripts.start: concurrently "cd client && npm start" "cd server && npm run dev"
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd client && npm start" "cd server && npm run dev"
scripts.test: cd client && npm test && cd server && npm test
scripts.lint: cd client && npm run lint && cd server && npm run lint
scripts.format: cd client && npm run format && cd server && npm run format
scripts.install: cd client && npm install && cd server && npm install
